normal_scientific_entry.direct_lineage: Direct mathematical reference and all material/physical settings come from immutable current and previously published source text, frozen in the trigger commit. Run38 numerical fields and Run37/36 points are independent historical results.
normal_scientific_entry.whole_geometry: two full unit material disks, full central extrusion, both rounded ends and both filled planar caps; selected material on the closed surface

samples.program: Five initial material vector solves, two complete joint layers in each of two geometry classes, and two same-source metric layers on the selected geometry. Up to eleven returned stages.
samples.frozen_target: induced Gram of the immutable true geometric source at its recorded selected physical coefficients and degree; both subsequent layers use the same full material target.

normal_scientific_entry.true_frozen_quantity: induced Gram of the immutable true geometric source at its recorded selected physical coefficients and degree; both subsequent layers use the same full material target.
normal_scientific_entry.stage_point: Each actual physical coefficient vector z and intrinsic material vector x has its own scientific SHA. The complete point is their ordered concatenation (z,x). Each whole stage NPZ and the full summary have independent recorded lengths and SHA-256.
normal_scientific_entry.limits: Working source evaluations and finite grids have the meaning declared in the scientific program. Global isometry, fixed-target convergence, regular flow, closed C2 embedding, reach, held and Euclidean separation need evidence for the exact same material and actual physical point. No flow integration on the full material atlas is inferred from a fixed-time-zero metric or a six-phase image cloud.
